scope: Read-only review of release admission and ZIP packaging; authorized narrow remediation of the Pages export workflow. This receipt is code-review evidence, not release approval or evidence that GitHub deployment has run.

originalFinding.issue: The previous Pages workflow rebuilt after approval and uploaded all of site/dist, while the release gate authenticated listed hashes but did not reject unlisted files. A new docs page or stale static file could therefore be uploaded without an approved hash.
originalFinding.resolution: Pages now invokes the approval gate and exports only the sealed website manifest plus the two fixed approval-envelope files into a fresh directory. The workflow uploads only this directory and performs no rebuild after approval.

checks: The release gate binds INPUTS, required renewed formal/semantic/paper/second-review receipts and the exact RELEASE-FILES manifest; it rejects changed approved repository files and inconsistent root/website approval envelopes.

ZIP packaging authenticates the release gate, copies only the repository/website allowlists and fixed approval envelopes, verifies source hashes before packaging, and verifies every archived byte and file-set equality afterward.

The deployment exporter authenticates the gate; rejects preexisting output, root escapes, noncanonical paths, case collisions, links/reparse points and missing or altered inputs; authenticates exact copied bytes; and verifies the final output allowlist.
The Pages workflow uploads only the fresh allowlist export, without rebuilding or injecting a deployment URL into approved pages.
The separate validation workflow may rebuild for testing; it has no deployment job or Pages write permission.
.gitattributes disables Git text normalization, preserving the line endings included in the audited hashes.
HOSTING describes sealed-byte deployment and explicitly requires renewed display/link checks and resealing for address-specific canonical links or sitemap changes.
realCliNegativeControl: The current CLI rejected the changed, not-yet-resealed Pages workflow at INPUTS verification and created no output directory.
remainingReleaseSteps: Root must reseal the changed helper, workflow and hosting documentation and its rendered view.
Root must run the exporter against the completed approval envelope and verify the resulting deployment directory before delivery.
